results.title: The best gay bars in Bangkok: a 2026 guide
excerpts:
## Silom

Silom Soi 2 and Soi 4 are the centre of Bangkok's gay nightlife, with a dozen bars and clubs a short walk apart.
Example Bar opens at 21:00 and has a drag show every Friday. Most venues are free to enter before midnight.

results.title: Bangkok Pride programme
excerpts: The parade starts at 14:00 on Sunday and finishes at the festival ground. Stages, food stalls and a community village open from noon.
